artifacts.summary: All eight plan phases complete; closed Phase 8's verification sweep and recorded the doc-lint baseline-drift deviation.

completion_data.completion_summary: Closed the final open phase (Phase 8, a report-only verification sweep) of the MCP ownership hybrid rewrite: ran and passed the full gate set (jq checks on four settings fragments, script syntax check, doc-lint no-new-failure check, task-reference lint, contradiction grep, git-status scope check), checked off all remaining plan checklists, and marked Phase 8 [COMPLETED]. Phases 1-7 were already committed by prior dispatches.

memory_candidates.content: When a plan's Phase 8 verification step demands a byte-identical doc-lint diff against a captured baseline, treat the baseline as time-bound: if enough calendar time passes between capture and the verification dispatch, unrelated repo drift (other tasks' edits to index-entries.json-tracked files) will inflate the diff. The correct verification is not the literal byte-diff but grepping the current doc-lint output for the task's own edited files and confirming zero hits, plus confirming the specific extensions this task touched still PASS. Record this substitution explicitly as a deviation rather than silently declaring the phase failed or silently fudging the byte-diff check.
